name: The Burning of Tula Valdi's Zozobra
source:
While attending his village's annual festival, a maneless lion named Tula locks eyes with the most important person in his life. 

They exchange no words.
They do not approach each other.
They leave alone, carrying one glance between them.

In this visual novel, you will trace Tula's year across various scattered recollections, uneventful workdays, and internal quandaries as he counts down the days until next year's festival. 

All he wants is two things:
To see this person again, and to understand why. 

[From [url=https://definitelypisk.itch.io/the-burning-of-tula-valdi-s-zozobra]Itch.io[/url]]
